references.text: The prohibition against making carved images or cast idols is given in the Ten Commandments.
Aaron made the golden calf by casting it, just as Micah's mother had a cast image made.
A curse is pronounced on anyone who makes a carved or cast image.
Description of how a craftsman makes an idol, similar to the silversmith who made the image for Micah's mother.
The prophet asks who would form a god or cast an image that is of no use.
The carved image and the cast image from Micah's house are mentioned again when the Danites steal them.
Israel used their silver and gold to make idols, just as the silver was used here.
